title: PAL halts Riyadh flights after strikes on Saudi airports

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Flag carrier Philippine Airlines (PAL) said Thursday it is canceling two flights connecting Manila and Riyadh, the capital of Saudi Arabia, whose airports have been struck by Yemen’s Houthis in another escalation of fighting in the Middle East. PAL said it had decided to cancel the Riyadh-bound flight on Oct. 8 (PR654) and the return flight to Manila scheduled for Oct. 10 (PR655) “in light of the developing situation in the region.” READ: PAL restarts Riyadh flights as Middle East tensions ease It has yet to advise on what will happen to flights thereafter, saying it is still monitoring […]...
